articulation.label: birthday
articulation.alt: birthday: /b/ → /ɝ/ → /θ/ → /d/ → /eɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ɝ/: Bunch the tongue for American r; no tip contact.
/θ/: Tongue tip lightly at or between the teeth.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
